description: Look up UK hospitals by name, town or postcode. Returns each one's address, whether Findway has a map of its inside (and what it shows), its Findway page, and links to directions to the hospital in Apple Maps or Google Maps.

limit.description: How many hospitals to return, 1 to 10 (default 5).

query.description: A hospital name, town or postcode.
